  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderProperties" name="Provide chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_OrderProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductionUpdate" name="Send production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstChainsaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_OrderProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrive" name="Parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce chainsaw and send updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FirstChainsawLiked"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstChainsawLiked" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="End_Production"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts after they arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates" name="Produce chainsaws and send updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" name="Assemble parts into the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOpinion" name="Receive the customer's opinion of the first chainsaw" messageRef="Message_CustomerOpinion">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikes" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemaining" name="Produce the rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderProduced" name="Rest of the order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotLiked" name="Customer does not like the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular customer updates during production" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdatesSent" name="Production updates complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOpinion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOpinion" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Customer likes the first chainsaw" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Customer does not like the first chainsaw" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="End_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="End_OrderProduced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="End_UpdatesSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
